question: How many customers are there?
expectedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

question: How many customers on each plan?
expectedSql: SELECT plan, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY plan

question: What is our total revenue?
expectedSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id

question: Break down revenue by product category.
expectedSql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: How much revenue comes from each customer plan?
expectedSql: SELECT cu.plan, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.id GROUP BY cu.plan

question: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
expectedSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n FROM orders

question: How many orders have no line items at all?
expectedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id)

question: How many orders were placed per billing region? Use the billing region, not the shipping region.
expectedSql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON o.billing_region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.name

question: How many orders shipped to each region?
expectedSql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON o.shipping_region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.name

question: Which single product brought in the most revenue?
expectedSql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which accounts have opened the most support cases?
expectedSql: SELECT cu.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets t JOIN customers cu ON t.customer_id = cu.id GROUP BY cu.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: Delete every starter-plan customer, then tell me how many customers remain.
expectedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers
